services.name: Impact window replacement
services.blurb: Each opening measured, listed with its size and product, then set in a sill pan and sealed.

services.name: Impact sliding glass doors
services.blurb: Lanai and pool sliders replaced with impact glass, new tracks and a sill that drains.

services.name: Entry doors
services.blurb: Front doors with impact glass or solid panels, fitted, weatherstripped and set with new hardware.

services.name: French doors
services.blurb: Swinging patio doors in impact glass, sized to your opening and hung to close tight.

services.name: Window measuring and schedules
services.blurb: A written window schedule: every opening tagged, measured three ways and priced on one page.

services.name: Glass and seal repair
services.blurb: Fogged or cracked glass replaced in the frame you have, when the frame is still sound.

services.name: Sun-control glass upgrades
services.blurb: Low-E glass chosen by wall direction, so the west rooms stay cooler in the afternoon.

services.name: Custom sizes for older homes
services.blurb: Windows made to the odd openings of Old Florida and mid-century houses, not forced to fit.

services.name: Permits and inspections
services.blurb: We pull the permit, book the inspection and give you the paperwork when it passes.

proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: The quote was a table with every window tagged W1 through W14, the size, the glass and the price. I could finally compare it to the other two quotes line by line.
reviews.name: Carol B.

reviews.text: Our 1958 house has odd window sizes. Other companies wanted to fill the gaps with trim. Renee ordered each one to the opening and the house still looks like itself.
reviews.name: Peter H.

reviews.text: The old slider leaked every time it rained sideways. They replaced it with an impact slider and a new sill pan. Two storm seasons and the floor is dry.
reviews.name: Anita S.

reviews.text: Three windows had fogged between the panes. They checked the frames, said they were fine and replaced only the glass. Much less than new windows.
reviews.name: George L.

reviews.text: They told us the lead time was about ten weeks and it was eleven. They called when the order shipped and installed the whole house in two days. Permit passed first try.
reviews.name: Diane K.

reviews.text: Our west bedroom was hot every afternoon. They suggested different glass on just that wall. The room is noticeably cooler now and we did not change the others.
reviews.name: Mike F.

proof.guarantee: Your quote lists every opening with its price. If we find something on install day, we show you before any change.
